formats.key: placeBid(address _nftAddress, uint256 _tokenId, (address loanAddress, uint256 loanId, uint256 highestBid, uint256 triggerFee, uint256 minBid, address highestBidder, uint96 duration, address asset, uint96 startTime, address originator, uint96 lastBidTime, bytes32 loanHash, uint96 buyoutWindow) _auction, uint256 _bid)
effects: The signer sends _bid of _auction.asset (pulled from their allowance) to the liquidator contract, which holds it in escrow as the new top bid.

The signer becomes the auction's highest bidder. If the signer wins and the auction is settled, they get the collateral NFT (_nftAddress #_tokenId); if someone outbids them, they get the bid back (pushed to them, or held as a pending refund they can claim).
The previous top bidder gets _auction.highestBid back from the contract. That is the signer only when the signer was already the top bidder.
The bid must be at least the effective minimum bid and more than 105% of the current top bid, or the call reverts. It also reverts while the main lender's buyout window is open.
formats.shown: "Bid 1.2 WETH for Quirkies #4543", with the bid amount and token, the NFT, the loan contract, the loan ID and the current top bid in WETH.

findings.title: placeBid: the funds go to the liquidator, but the only address shown is 'Loan contract'.
findings.evidence: AuctionLoanLiquidator.placeBid: token.safeTransferFrom(newBidder, address(this), _bid); descriptor shows _auction.loanAddress labelled 'Loan contract' (case 0: 0xE365…Ac0a), which is not where the bid goes.
findings.fix: Optionally say in the intent that the bid is held in escrow by the liquidator and refunded if outbid, e.g. 'Bid {_bid} for {_tokenId} (refunded if outbid)'.

findings.title: placeBid: the intent does not say the bid is escrowed, refunded if outbid, and wins the NFT only after settlement.
findings.evidence: AuctionLoanLiquidator.placeBid refunds the previous highestBidder with trySafeTransfer or _pendingRefunds; the NFT moves only in settleAuction. Intent: 'Bid on liquidation auction'.
findings.fix: Add a short note to the intent, e.g. 'Bid {_bid} for {_tokenId}; refunded if outbid'.

formats.key: settleAuction((address loanAddress, uint256 loanId, uint256 highestBid, uint256 triggerFee, uint256 minBid, address highestBidder, uint96 duration, address asset, uint96 startTime, address originator, uint96 lastBidTime, bytes32 loanHash, uint96 buyoutWindow) _auction, (address borrower, uint256 nftCollateralTokenId, address nftCollateralAddress, address principalAddress, uint256 principalAmount, uint256 startTime, uint256 duration, (uint256 loanId, uint256 floor, uint256 principalAmount, address lender, uint256 accruedInterest, uint256 startTime, uint256 aprBps)[] tranche, uint256 protocolFee, bool lenderRefinanceDisabled) _loan)
effects: The collateral NFT (_loan.nftCollateralAddress #_loan.nftCollateralTokenId) goes from the liquidator to _auction.highestBidder (the signer only if the signer is the winner).
The signer, as settler, receives a trigger fee of highestBid * _auction.triggerFee / 10000 in _auction.asset. The originator receives the same amount.

The rest (highestBid - 2 * triggerFee) is approved to the LiquidationDistributor and paid out by it to the loan's lenders and borrower. The signer receives part of it if they are a lender or the borrower.
The signer pays nothing. The auction record is deleted.
formats.shown: "Settle auction of Quirkies #4543", with the loan contract, loan ID, winning bid in WETH, winner, collateral NFT, loan principal, borrower, lenders and a raw 'No lender refinance: true' flag.

findings.title: settleAuction: the settler's trigger-fee reward is paid to the signer but its rate is hidden.
findings.evidence: AuctionLoanLiquidator.settleAuction: triggerFee = highestBid.mulDivDown(_auction.triggerFee, _BPS); asset.safeTransfer(msg.sender, triggerFee); descriptor: _auction.triggerFee 'Trigger fee' visible: never. In case 1 the auction's triggerFee is 0, so nothing is paid there.
findings.fix: Show _auction.triggerFee as 'Settler reward' using unit format with base 'bps' (or decimals 2 with a '%' unit), or state it in the intent.

findings.title: settleAuction: the sentence does not say who receives the NFT.
findings.evidence: settleAuction: ERC721(collateralAddress).transferFrom(address(this), _auction.highestBidder, tokenId); interpolatedIntent 'Settle auction of {_loan.nftCollateralTokenId}'. The winner appears only as a separate 'Winner' field.

findings.title: settleAuction: a raw, double-negative 'No lender refinance' flag is shown that has no bearing on settlement.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field _loan.lenderRefinanceDisabled 'No lender refinance' format raw, visible always (case 1 shows 'true'). settleAuction only uses it through the loan hash check.

findings.title: settleAuction: how the LiquidationDistributor pays out lenders and borrower is decided by code outside the calldata.
findings.evidence: settleAuction: _liquidationDistributor.distribute(_auction.loanAddress, proceeds, _loan); the distributor address comes from storage, and its source is not in the directory.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The winning bid and loan principal are shown as context.

couldNotCheck: settleAuction calls _liquidationDistributor.distribute (0x1C495e474C63B5B095173ca0bd9DE1B9F002D75d), whose source is not in the directory. It decides how the proceeds are split between lenders and the borrower, which matters when the signer is one of them.
